A_MIGRATION_AND_SCHEMA.root_cause: Alembic migration heads progressed to 0043; test hardcoded earlier migration heads.
A_MIGRATION_AND_SCHEMA.remediation: Updated valid head list to include 0042 and 0043; validated property schema columns.

B_ROUTER_DEPENDENCY_OVERRIDES.root_cause: Endpoints protected by get_current_tenant returned 401 in tests lacking tenant context mock.
B_ROUTER_DEPENDENCY_OVERRIDES.remediation: Added app.dependency_overrides[get_current_tenant] returning valid mock tenant context.

C_SECURITY_STATIC_ANALYSIS.root_cause: AST scanner matched variable naming 'target_organization_id' in autonomous loop router; broader filesystem scan matched virtualenv scripts.
C_SECURITY_STATIC_ANALYSIS.remediation: Renamed variable to target_org; restricted scanner path to apps/api/app.

D_NON_UUID_AMBIENT_LEAKAGE.root_cause: String organization identifiers like 'org-enterprise-01' from ambient context triggered ValueError in uuid.UUID casting.
D_NON_UUID_AMBIENT_LEAKAGE.remediation: Implemented _safe_org_uuid with deterministic uuid5 fallback, sanitized ambient tenant resolution, and added clear_ambient_tenant fixture.

E_AUTONOMY_GOVERNANCE_AND_APPROVALS.root_cause: Governed action execution required proper sequence of authorization token validation and human approval gating; low-risk read actions required autonomous governed execution without shadow blockage.
E_AUTONOMY_GOVERNANCE_AND_APPROVALS.remediation: Hardened GovernedActionExecutor execution ordering, passed has_human_approval to canonical messaging, and enabled AUTONOMOUS_GOVERNED for low-risk read operations.

F_CERTIFICATION_SNAPSHOT_SEQUENCE.root_cause: Async mock session execute sequence lacked scalar return for human decisions count query.
F_CERTIFICATION_SNAPSHOT_SEQUENCE.remediation: Added scalar count value to mock database execute results.

G_QUALIFICATION_POLICY_SNAPSHOT.remediation: Verified and validated with mock async session.

H_WEBHOOK_HMAC_VERIFICATION.root_cause: Test payload lacked required HMAC-SHA256 signature for configured WhatsApp provider secret.
H_WEBHOOK_HMAC_VERIFICATION.remediation: Supplied valid HMAC signature in test DTO and added explicit test verifying 401 rejection on invalid signature.

I_OAUTH_MULTIWORKER_CONNECTION.root_cause: Asyncpg event loop closure during full suite multi-worker run.

J_PROPERTY_INTELLIGENCE_TENANCY.root_cause: Test brokers created in unit test fixtures lacked Organization and OrganizationMember rows, causing canonical tenant isolation to reject access.
J_PROPERTY_INTELLIGENCE_TENANCY.remediation: Created explicit Organization and OrganizationMember records in test setups, ensuring legitimate tenant membership without compromising fail-closed security.
